title: Windows/tasks grouped into one button don't clear attention required and the panel does not hide
line: An auto-hiding panel now hides again after you visit the windows that wanted attention from a grouped task's list.
explanation: The group popup saved the task manager's status when it opened ("needs attention" while windows were waiting) and wrote that saved value back when it closed. Picking the waiting windows from the popup clears their attention while it is open, so on closing the stale "needs attention" came back, and nothing reset it until windows changed attention again or Plasma restarted, so auto-hide and dodge-windows panels stayed shown. The popup no longer saves or restores the status; the task manager's status binding itself keeps the panel shown while the popup is open and goes back to the real attention state when it closes.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: don't keep panel shown after group popup closes

The group popup saved the applet status on opening and wrote it back on
closing, so attention cleared from the popup came back and kept auto
hide panels shown. The status binding now keeps them shown while open.

BUG: 511950

media.caption: Master: every window in the group's list has been visited, none is orange any more
Master: after closing the list the auto-hide panel stays shown, with the pointer far away
With the fix: same steps, every window visited from the list
With the fix: after closing the list the panel hides

review.text: This fixes the real cause: the dialog saved the stale applet status and wrote it back on close. Moving 'popup open' into the existing status binding is simpler than before (net code removed). It verifies cleanly with the keyboard, and the regression cases cover attention both while open and after closing.
